name: What are the main types of architectural drawings for a home project?

mainEntity.name: What are the main types of architectural drawings for a home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key types include site plans, floor plans, elevations, sections, details, and schedules that together define layout, structure, finishes, and how elements come together.
